title: 970 解惑969 彭敢飞的修为
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：混沌书正文970.解惑（..la）吕一仁几乎是立刻站了起来，动作快得带倒了手边的酒杯，琥珀色的酒液在桌面上洇开一小片水渍，他却浑然未觉。
他的脸上先是惊喜，随即又涌上一种复杂的迟疑，像是被一个从天而降的机会砸中后，本能地想要抓住，却又担心自己伸手的姿势不够端正。
他转头看了看吕小倩，两人交换了一个心照不宣的眼神，然后他拉着妻子，就要朝洛豪弯腰拜下去。
那是他刻进骨子里的习惯，从在修真界创立灵药谷，到飞升仙界后四处漂泊，他始终相信，学艺就应当拜师，拜师就要行大礼，规矩是根，不可废，可他刚躬身到一半，洛豪已经伸出一只手，虚虚一抬，没有碰到他的身体，却用一股柔和而坚定的气息托住了他下拜的势头。
“吕兄，不必如此。”
洛豪的声音不大，却带着一种让人无法抗拒的笃定，
“你的修为比我高，资历比我深，灵药谷开派祖师的位份摆在那里，我哪里受得起你的拜师礼。
我们平辈论交，你叫我洛丹师也好，叫我洛兄也好，就是别叫师父。
炼丹上的事，我能说的一定说，能教的不会藏私，但不需那些虚礼。”
吕一仁愣了一瞬，他直起身，看着洛豪那张年轻得不像话的脸，嘴唇翕动了一下，想要再说些什么，可最终只是轻轻叹了口气，像是将那口积压了无数年的沉郁缓缓地吐了出来，他没有坚持，只抱了抱拳，声音沉而稳，
“那便听洛兄的。”
洛豪点了点头，随即看了一眼吕一仁面前的丹炉，
“你先炼一炉丹给我看看。
就炼一炉你最拿手的，不要刻意挑简单的，也不要想着一口吃成胖子，就按你平时炼丹的节奏来。”
吕一仁应了一声，重新在蒲团上坐下，深吸一口气，神情从方才的感激和激动中缓缓沉淀下来，恢复到一种炼丹者特有的专注，他右手一翻，一尊通体暗红、表面刻着古朴云纹的丹炉便稳稳地落在了面前的石台上。
紧跟着，一缕细而柔和的火焰从他指尖升腾而起，颜色是温润的青色，带着一种清冷而灵动的光芒，绕着丹炉底部轻轻转动，很快便将炉壁均匀地加热到合适的温度。
那是星星之火，在仙界奇异火种中排名也算靠前，如今已经呈现出成熟的青色，火力稳定而内敛，看得出被吕一仁温养了很多年，洛豪的目光在火焰上停了片刻，没有说话，只是安静地看着他接下来的每一个步骤。
吕一仁从储物戒指中取出一份仙灵草，赫然是地真丹的材料。
他选择的是自己最熟悉、炼过千百遍的丹方，动作几乎没有犹豫——投料、融化、提纯、融合，每一步都流畅而熟练，带着一种经年累月磨出来的肌肉记忆。
他的神识操控着药液的流动，他的手指翻动间掐出分丹诀和拉丹诀，从外围看去，几乎挑不出什么明显的毛病。

可到了聚灵成丹的关键节点，洛豪的眉头还是轻轻动了一下，他看见吕一仁的手法不自觉地走回了修真界炼丹的老路子——他依然在用“聚灵”
的方式去处理“成丹”
，试图强行将仙灵气压缩进药液之中，就像在往一只已经装满水的杯子里继续倒水。
那些药液在他的神识操控下剧烈地震荡，想要吸纳仙灵气，却又被他的手法堵住了通道，最后像一只被堵住出口的气球，内部压力不断升高，丹药半成品开始出现细密的裂纹，药香变得杂乱而浑浊。
一炉丹药出炉，十二枚浑圆的药丸，颜色尚可，形状也规整，但没有一丝仙韵流转。
它们安静地躺在冷却的丹炉底部，像是被抽走了魂魄的躯壳，徒有其表，内里空无一物，显然是废丹。
吕一仁没有惊讶，他只是沉默地看着那十二颗丹药，像是已经习惯了这样的结局，他的手还停在丹炉边缘，指尖余温未散，目光却有些放空，吕小倩在旁边没有出声，只是将手轻轻搭在他的后背上，像是用这种无声的触碰告诉他，没关系。
洛豪轻轻叹了口气，这个场景，他太熟悉了，当初在璇玑仙站那个边缘舱里，他第一次炼制炼地丹时，犯的错几乎一模一样，聚灵手法是修真界的丹道逻辑，而仙丹需要的是“成丹”
的逻辑。
一字之差，便是天壤之别，更不要说吕一仁在释放丹药时也没有很好地保留住药液中的仙韵，那股本该融入丹药本源的灵气，在他收丹的一瞬被泄去了大半。
不是吕一仁资质不够，也不是他丹道功底差，而是他一个人在黑暗中摸索得太久了，飞升仙界之后，他一直在疲于奔命，躲追杀、藏身份、换地方，根本没有条件沉下心来，也没有人可以交流。
仙丹师在仙界的地位太高了，高到普通地仙上仙根本不敢轻易接近，更别提坐下来讨论炼丹心得，而在修真界，丹王之间还能互相切磋、交换经验，可在仙界，吕一仁连一个可以问问题的人都找不到。
洛豪知道，自己之所以能跨过那道坎，靠的完全是混沌万物决的推演能力，那门功法就像一位从不说话的师父，每一次失败都会在他脑海中自动复盘，告诉他哪里错了、该怎么改。
没有它，他也许会和吕一仁一样，在九品丹王的门槛上卡上数千年甚至数万年。
他没有多说什么，从储物戒指中取出一枚空白的玉简，贴在额前，将自己关于“聚灵与成丹之辨”
“如何锁住仙韵”
“分丹诀的细微调整”
等心得刻了进去。
那些话不是长篇大论的丹道理论，而是一些细碎却关键的点——就像给迷路的人画一条小路，不需要解释整座山，只需要告诉他哪块石头可以踩、哪根藤可以抓。
片刻之后，他将玉简递给吕一仁，

“你看看这个。
下一炉丹药，你就可以炼制出来仙丹了。”
“就这么简单？……”
吕一仁还以为洛豪在消遣他，就算是自己的方法不对，也不至于只要看看他的玉简，下一炉就可以炼制仙丹了吧？
他像是生怕洛豪会反悔似的，又往玉简里探了一次神识，确认自己没有看错，没有记错，没有误解什么，那上面写的确实是“成丹”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chaos Book Text 970. Solve the Puzzles (..la) Lu Yiren stood up almost immediately, and he tipped the wine glass at hand so quickly that the amber wine spread a small water stain on the table, but he was completely unaware of it.
There was surprise on his face at first, and then there was a complex hesitation, as if after being hit by an opportunity falling from the sky, he instinctively wanted to grab it, but he was worried that his posture of reaching out was not correct enough.
He turned to look at Lu Xiaoqian, and the two exchanged a tacit look. Then he pulled his wife and bowed down to Luo Hao.
That was a habit engraved in his bones. From establishing the Spiritual Medicine Valley in the world of cultivation to wandering around after ascending to the Immortal World, he always believed that to learn skills, one should apprentice to a master, and to do so, one should bow to a master. Rules are fundamental and cannot be broken. But when he was halfway through bowing, Luo Hao had already stretched out a hand and raised it weakly. It did not touch his body, but supported his momentum of bowing with a soft and firm breath.
"Brother Lu, it doesn't have to be like this."
Luo Hao's voice was not loud, but it carried an irresistible determination.
"Your cultivation level is higher than mine, and your qualifications are more senior than mine. Given your status as the founder of the Spiritual Medicine Valley Kai Sect, how can I afford your apprenticeship ceremony?
We are friends of the same generation. You can call me Alchemist Luo or Brother Luo, but don’t call me Master.
Regarding alchemy, I will definitely tell you what I can say, and those who can teach will not hide their secrets, but there is no need for those false etiquette. "
Lu Yiren was stunned for a moment. He straightened up and looked at Luo Hao's unbelievably young face. He moved his lips and wanted to say something more, but in the end he just sighed softly, as if he was slowly spitting out the depression that had been accumulated for countless years. He did not insist, only clasped his fists, and spoke in a deep and steady voice.
"Then just listen to Brother Luo."
Luo Hao nodded, and then glanced at the alchemy furnace in front of Lu Yiren.
"You first make a furnace of elixirs and show them to me.
Just make a furnace of what you are best at. Don't deliberately pick the easy ones, and don't think about getting fat in one bite. Just follow your usual rhythm of making alchemy. "
Lu Yiren responded, sat down on the futon again, took a deep breath, his expression slowly settled down from the gratitude and excitement just now, and returned to the concentration unique to an alchemist. He turned his right hand, and a dark red alchemy furnace with ancient cloud patterns carved on the surface landed steadily on the stone platform in front of him.
Immediately afterwards, a thin and soft flame rose from his fingertips. The color was warm cyan, with a cool and agile light. It gently rotated around the bottom of the alchemy furnace, and soon heated the furnace wall evenly to the appropriate temperature.
It was a spark of fire, ranking high among the strange fires in the fairy world. Now it has shown a mature cyan color. The firepower is stable and restrained. It can be seen that it has been nurtured by Lu Yiren for many years. Luo Hao's eyes stopped on the flame for a moment. He did not speak, but quietly watched every step he took.
Lu Yiren took out a piece of fairy grass from the storage ring, which was the material of the Earth True Pill.
He chose the elixir recipe that he was most familiar with and had practiced it thousands of times. There was almost no hesitation in his movements - adding ingredients, melting, purifying, and blending. Every step was smooth and skillful, with a kind of muscle memory honed over many years.
His consciousness controlled the flow of the medicinal liquid, and he flipped his fingers to pick out the Pill-Spinning Jue and the Ladan-Jue. From the outside, there were almost no obvious flaws.
But when it came to the critical point of gathering souls to make pills, Luo Hao's brows moved slightly. He saw that Lu Yiren's method unconsciously went back to the old way of making pills in the world of cultivation - he was still using "Gathering Spirits"
The way to deal with "Cheng Dan"
, trying to forcefully compress the fairy spirit energy into the liquid medicine, is like pouring water into a cup that is already filled with water.
Those medicinal liquids vibrated violently under the control of his spiritual consciousness, trying to absorb the immortal spiritual energy, but the channels were blocked by his techniques.In the end, like a balloon with its outlet blocked, the internal pressure continued to rise, fine cracks began to appear in the semi-finished elixir, and the aroma of the medicine became messy and turbid.
A furnace of elixirs came out, twelve round pills, the color was acceptable and the shape was regular, but there was no trace of fairy charm.
They lie quietly at the bottom of the cooling alchemy furnace, like bodies whose souls have been taken away. They are only superficial and empty inside. They are obviously useless elixirs.
Lu Yiren was not surprised. He just looked at the twelve pills silently, as if he was used to such an ending. His hand was still on the edge of the pill furnace, the warmth on his fingertips had not dissipated, but his eyes were a little vacant. Lu Xiaoqian did not make a sound beside him, but just put her hand gently on his back, as if telling him with this silent touch that it didn't matter.
Luo Hao sighed softly. He was too familiar with this scene. When he first refined the Earth Refining Pill in the edge cabin of the Xuanji Immortal Station, he made almost the same mistake. The spirit gathering technique is the logic of alchemy in the world of cultivation, and the elixir requires a "Cheng Dan".
logic.
The difference of one word is a world of difference, not to mention that Lu Yiren did not retain the immortal charm in the elixir well when releasing the elixir. Most of the aura that should have been integrated into the origin of the elixir was leaked out the moment he collected the elixir.
It's not that Lu Yiren is not qualified enough, or that his alchemy skills are poor, but that he has been groping alone in the darkness for too long. After ascending to the immortal world, he has been running around trying to avoid being hunted, hiding his identity, and changing places. He has no conditions to calm down and no one to communicate with.
The status of the elixir master in the immortal world is so high that ordinary earthly immortals would not even dare to approach him easily, let alone sit down and discuss their alchemy experiences. In the world of cultivation, alchemy masters can also compete with each other and exchange experiences, but in the immortal world, Lu Yiren can't even find anyone to ask questions.
Luo Hao knew that the reason why he could cross that hurdle was entirely due to the deduction ability of Chaos Wanwujue. That technique was like a master who never spoke. Every time he failed, it would automatically review it in his mind, telling him where he went wrong and how to correct it.
Without it, like Lu Yiren, he might be stuck on the threshold of the ninth-grade Alchemy King for thousands or even tens of thousands of years.
He didn't say anything more. He took out a blank jade slip from his storage ring, put it on his forehead, and wrote about "the difference between gathering spirits and forming pills."
"How to lock in the fairy charm"
"Subtle adjustments to the Pill-Spinning Technique"
Wait for your thoughts to sink in.
Those words are not long-winded alchemy theories, but some small but key points - just like drawing a path for a lost person. You don't need to explain the entire mountain, you just need to tell him which stones can be stepped on and which vines can be grasped.
After a while, he handed the jade slip to Lu Yiren,
"Look at this.
With the next batch of elixirs, you can refine the elixir. "
"Is it that simple?..."
Lu Yiren thought Luo Hao was entertaining him. Even if his method was wrong, he wouldn't just look at his jade slips and refine the elixir in the next batch, right?
As if he was afraid that Luo Hao would regret it, he searched the jade slip with his spiritual sense again to confirm that he had not read it wrong, remembered it wrong, or misunderstood anything. The words written on it were indeed "Cheng Dan"
